name: Stardust Journey
source:
What would happen if you were suddenly transported onto a mysterious beach party after not finishing your [url=https://artfight.net]Artfight[/url] hitlist for years?

Stardust Journey is a short 2D visual novel with point-and-click elements that features various OCs from Artfight artists! 

[From [url=https://diadantist.itch.io/stardustjourney-artfight]itch.io[/url]]
